title: Osmanlı Pâdişah Türbeleri Ottoman rulers’ tombs
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: This book deals with the tombs (türbe) of the thirty-six Ottoman rulers and their histories. Dates of birth, reign and death, other information about their lives, wills (if any), imperial monograms (tuğra), images of coins and a portrait (real or fictitious) of each ruler accompany the photos of the Ottoman imperial funeral monuments.
